summary: When tasks.json remains active but runtime checkpoint/context/execution evidence is already terminal, maintenance must restore task truth from runtime evidence before heartbeat timeout reconciliation.
symptoms: tasks.json shows timed_out or running while factory/runtime/tasks/<task_id>/context.json is completed or failed
graph nodes are requeued even though the detached runner already finished
root_cause: maintenance trusted tasks.json active status before consulting terminal checkpoint/runtime evidence
heartbeat recovery requeued nodes from stale task-table state and overwrote real terminal outcomes
fix: restore task status from execution-evidence/context/checkpoint terminal state before heartbeat timeout logic
repair graph nodes that were requeued from stale active task records
